description: This file defines the ShapeTemplateBindingStrategy class, which extends ShapeTableProvider and implements IShapeTableHarvester. It manages shape template harvesting and binding logic within the OrchardCore display management system, including discovering shape templates, associating them with features, and rendering views.

classes.name: ShapeTemplateBindingStrategy
classes.description: A class responsible for discovering shape templates, associating them with features, and binding them for rendering within OrchardCore's display management system.

methods.name: ShapeTemplateBindingStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies, setting up view engine mappings, and preparing the strategy.

methods.name: DiscoverAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously discovers shape templates, filters active features, and binds templates to shape types for rendering.
